completion_conditions.statement: All files listed by the Core Plan exist with the planned Core semantics and no implementation file outside accepted Plan scope is required for Core operation.
Build mutation scope, declared predecessor use, Plan-prescribed validation, and repository validation all conform.
Governance can record explicit non-circular Planning and Build acceptance with bounded authorization and resolvable Core lineage.
Each retained Core normative requirement has valid identity, mechanically accepted normative force, and governed Conformance and Assurance applicability.
Minimal durable Conformance, Assurance, and Build mutation evidence required by Core acceptance is schema-valid and resolvable from acceptance lineage.
The built FS0-Core runtime can validate, semantically review, build, and govern acceptance of the next functionality-defined functional set without out-of-band framework logic.
